mapping.summary: Checklist templates that attach to BC documents and records and can block release.
claims: Checklists appear on sales, purchase, service, project, manufacturing and master-data pages
No-code template designer with groups, headlines and mandatory, normal or additional items
Templates attach to records automatically by filter
Field lines write back to the record using BC validation
Choose allow, warn or block on release with open mandatory items
Inline editor with toggles, dropdowns, image drop zones and text areas
Checklists carry over from quote to order and onto posted documents
Print or save a checklist as PDF
Export templates to JSON, import from file or copy from another company
Works on over 30 pages out of the box
Service and manufacturing areas need Premium
